name: 98908 · Yakima, WA
findings: ZIP 98908 (Yakima) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98908 (Yakima) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98908 (Yakima) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
